about:
Hudson Electric Sales Corp. has been based in Hawthorne, New York, since its establishment in 1972. The company operates as a privately held business, though specific ownership structure and founder names are not publicly documented.

The company functions as a supplier of industrial switchgear and power distribution equipment, offering electrical control systems and switchgear tailored for commercial, industrial, and institutional applications. Its product range includes industrial switchgear and power distribution equipment, supported by a staff of 50 to 99 employees who manage procurement, technical support, and logistics.

The firm serves customers across industrial, commercial, and institutional markets, providing equipment for power distribution and control systems in facilities such as manufacturing plants, office buildings, and public institutions. Its client base includes organizations that require reliable electrical infrastructure components.

The company has not publicly stated a specific founding mission or differentiator beyond its role as a supplier of electrical equipment.
